SELECT home_store_id, COUNT(*) AS versions, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS current_members, MIN(join_date), MAX(join_date), SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_rows
FROM dim_member WHERE home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136,900,999) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, SUM(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS cur_members, MAX(valid_from), MIN(join_date), MAX(join_date) FROM dim_member

calls.statement:
WITH cur AS (SELECT member_id, home_store_id, join_date, marketing_consent FROM dim_member WHERE is_current),
tam AS (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND city='Tampere' AND store_id<900)
SELECT c.home_store_id,
 COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_id) AS members,
 SUM(CASE WHEN c.marketing_consent THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS consent,
 SUM(CASE WHEN c.join_date < DATE '2024-09-02' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS joined_before_open,
 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member m2 WHERE m2.member_id=c.member_id AND m2.home_store_id<>c.home_store_id) THEN c.member_id END) AS changed_store
FROM cur c JOIN tam ON tam.store_id=c.home_store_id GROUP BY ROLLUP(1) ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS ever_tampere_home FROM dim_member m WHERE m.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136)

WITH buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date > DATE '2026-10-04' - 364 AND f.sale_date <= DATE '2026-10-04'
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
cur AS (SELECT member_id, home_store_id FROM dim_member WHERE valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-04' AND valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-04')
SELECT c.home_store_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.member_id) AS members, COUNT(DISTINCT b.member_id) AS active
FROM cur c LEFT JOIN buyers b ON b.member_id=c.member_id
WHERE c.home_store_id IN (115,116,117,136) GROUP BY ROLLUP(1) ORDER BY 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS tampere_loyalty_members
FROM dim_member m
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_id = m.home_store_id AND s.is_current
WHERE m.is_current AND s.city = 'Tampere' AND s.store_id < 900
